ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a north-south topographic profile passing through the middle of Beijing urban area. On the left is the northern Yanshan Mountains, with large terrain undulations; the middle is marked “Beijing,” corresponding to the vicinity of the urban area; the right side extends southward with low and flat terrain, and 3 is located in the plain area south of Beijing urban area and is adjacent to the Yongding River marked in the figure. Reasoning: The question stem emphasizes laying out agricultural product processing areas according to the geographical advantages of various regions in Beijing. The area where 3 is located is not northern mountains, so it is not suitable to correspond to mountain fruit processing; it is also not near the core of the urban area, so it is not appropriate as a deep processing area with stronger technology and market orientation. Its low and flat plain and near-river conditions are more favorable for cultivated land use, irrigation, and vegetable production. Therefore, with processing layout oriented by raw material production areas, 3 most reasonably corresponds to a vegetable processing area.
